description: Checks one email address without sending anything: format, typo in big providers ("gmail.com.br" → "gmail.com", "hotmial.com"), disposable inbox, shared mailbox (contato@, sales@) and whether the domain receives email (MX). Verdict valid, risky or invalid, with did_you_mean. The mailbox itself is never probed. Free, read only. / Confere um endereço sem enviar nada: formato, erro de digitação, e-mail temporário, caixa compartilhada e se o domínio recebe e-mail.
name: verify_email
title: Verify an email address / Verificar e-mail
